== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata)]] (<code>1261_29</code>, Virtual Block 6.1 slip 31), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-31-Breached_Defenses_Molator.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-breacheddefenses&molator-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Breached Defenses & •Molator]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip (the ▲ take-into-hand arrow, the Virtual icon drawn as CardMaker's Virtual diamond).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] Crossfire on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to ▲ an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand the Empire). If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at the end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to Goo Nee Tay. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_29</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 31, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
